configurePresets.name: host-openmp
configurePresets.description: CPU build; portable everywhere, no GPU. Good for correctness/CI and for voronoi_dynamics. Run tools/bootstrap_deps.sh host-openmp first.

configurePresets.name: host-serial
configurePresets.description: Single-thread CPU build; Kokkos::Serial is the default execution space. The serial device baseline for benchmarking (Kokkos overhead vs raw serial C++) and a simple debug target. Run tools/bootstrap_deps.sh host-serial first.

configurePresets.name: nvidia-cuda
configurePresets.description: Local dev box: RTX 5080 / CUDA 13.2. The primary development target. Run tools/bootstrap_deps.sh nvidia-cuda first.

configurePresets.name: lumi-hip
configurePresets.displayName: LUMI (Kokkos HIP backend, AMD MI250X gfx90a)
configurePresets.description: AMD ROCm target. Not yet exercised (no LUMI access); kept in lockstep so the NVIDIA work stays portable. Run tools/bootstrap_deps.sh lumi-hip first.

configurePresets.name: host-openmp-ccache
configurePresets.description: As `host-openmp`, with ccache as the compiler launcher (docs/QUALITY_PLAN.md §3.G.8). Opt-in, and never implied by the plain preset: a cold cache costs a few percent, a warm one turns a full rebuild into a link. ccache must be on PATH. HOST BACKENDS ONLY -- on a CUDA/HIP prefix Kokkos already owns the compile rule's launcher with kokkos_launch_compiler and a second launcher breaks its redirect; there is no nvidia-cuda-ccache preset for that reason, and flow's CMake rejects the combination with the explanation.
